description: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets collected from single versus multiple platforms over time, from 2012 to 2022, with the y-axis representing the number of datasets and the x-axis showing the year. Blue bars, labeled "1" in the legend, represent datasets sourced from a single platform, while orange bars, labeled "2+", represent datasets collected from two or more platforms. In the early years, from 2012 to 2015, most datasets were sourced from a single platform, with very few from multiple platforms. The number of single-platform datasets increased gradually, reaching a peak of 112 in 2021. In contrast, the number of datasets from multiple platforms remained low until 2017, after which it began to rise significantly, reaching 47 in 2021 and 7 in 2022. The chart highlights a growing trend in researchers collecting data from multiple sources, particularly from 2018 onward, as indicated by the increasing height of the orange bars.
